name: FLORES+ Devtest — All Pairs
description: Multi-way parallel evaluation corpus from FLORES+. 197 languages, 1012 sentences each, all sentence-aligned. Generates 38,612 directional evaluation pairs at registry build time. HIGH contamination — scores should be used for relative comparison only, not absolute quality claims. Domain relabeled to 'mixed': FLORES+ sentences come from Wikinews (news), Wikijunior (edu) and Wikivoyage (descriptive/literary travel prose) — not pure news; domainDistribution is an approximate equal-thirds split across those three Wikimedia sources.

promotedSubset.rationale: A 30-language runnable slice of FLORES+ — high-resource anchors (eng/fra/spa/deu/rus/cmn/jpn/hin/arb/por), the Faroese→Ayacucho-Quechua keystone pair (fao→que), and a diverse low-resource spread across scripts and families. Promoted into the runnable lane behind the HIGH-contamination relative-comparison-only lane; the full 197-language catalogue stays catalogue-only. 30 languages → 870 ordered directional pairs.

languages.variety: Ayacucho Quechua (quy) — NOT Cusco quz; quz is not present in this subset

download.instructions: Gated HuggingFace dataset — accept the terms at the dataset page and set an HF access token in $HF_TOKEN. Per-language JSONL files at {segment}/{lang_code}.jsonl, aligned across languages by the integer sentence id.

source.citation: NLLB Team et al. (2022). No Language Left Behind: Scaling Human-Centered Machine Translation.

license.aiTraining: Permitted with attribution under CC-BY-SA-4.0 terms.

contamination.reasoning: FLORES+ is one of the most widely used MT benchmarks. The NLLB paper (§4) notes it was used to evaluate NLLB-200. Multiple frontier models (GPT-4, PaLM 2, Gemini) likely include FLORES data in training. Scores on FLORES+ from frontier LLMs should be interpreted as relative comparisons only, not absolute quality measures.

que.basis: FLORES+ upstream codes this record quy_Latn — Ayacucho Quechua (openlanguagedata/flores_plus; the registry entry's source_codes preserve quy_Latn).
